blocks.heading: What is XA5?
blocks.body: ACTH-fragment analog profile for cognitive and neuroprotective research. Coze describes Semax as a synthetic heptapeptide related to ACTH 4-10, originally developed in Russia and reviewed for neuroprotective, cognitive, neurotrophic, cerebrovascular recovery, and optic-nerve support research. SEMAX 10mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU XA10. Current storefront values use our product data: 10mg x 10 vials /box, $85.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 5mg x 10 vials / 10mg x 10 vials.

blocks.heading: Research context
blocks.body: Coze describes Semax as a synthetic heptapeptide related to ACTH 4-10, originally developed in Russia and reviewed for neuroprotective, cognitive, neurotrophic, cerebrovascular recovery, and optic-nerve support research. Research commonly reviews neurotrophic markers, cognition endpoints, stress-response context, and ACTH-fragment pathway literature.

blocks.heading: LPPeptide handling reference
blocks.body:

Coze preparation pattern: use sterile technique, add diluent slowly down the vial wall, avoid foaming, roll gently until dissolved, label the preparation date, refrigerate at 2-8 deg C, and protect from light.
